title: The Penal Quarry Quota
logline: Failing scrubbers in an asteroid penal mine force convict drillers to smuggle raw ice, while the warden schemes to destroy maintenance records before corporate auditors arrive.

roles.description: Supervises the asteroid extraction penal site; polite, bureaucratic, terrified of headquarters audits.
Elected by convict drilling teams to bargain for ration scrip; cynical, scarred, fiercely protective of the crews.
A subterranean mining outpost drilled deep into an airless carbonaceous asteroid.
An automated security cutter modified with heavy pulse lasers to police the quarry perimeter.
A decommissioned slag lock where off-shift convicts barter smuggled supplies.
A regional resource trust holding the correctional extraction lease from system authorities.

public_situation: Work teams at the penal asteroid quarry have fallen behind extraction quotas, prompting the management trust to freeze outbound mail.
private_truth: {role:quarry_warden} pocketed the environmental scrubber refurbishment fund, leaving {role:penal_rock_complex} dangerously short of breathable air.

beats.public_change: Emergency ration rationing is announced across all work levels of {role:penal_rock_complex}.

missions.reason: The delegate hires a freelance miner to bring unrefined ice directly to the secondary life-support condensers.
missions.private_fact: She is paying using stolen industrial diamond cutting heads stashed in the slag chute.

beats.public_change: {role:quarry_warden} declares an unscheduled contraband sweep and halts all private docking.

missions.reason: The warden hires the pilot to scan external maintenance shafts to pinpoint an unauthorized transmitter broadcasting distress bursts.
missions.private_fact: The broadcasts contain sensor logs proving that lower galleries are venting toxic ammonia.

beats.public_change: Shift leaders threaten a total extraction strike unless atmospheric scrubbers are brought to full power.

missions.reason: She needs the pilot to retrieve the station maintenance log slate hidden inside an unmonitored ore pod before guards locate it.
missions.private_fact: The slate details the warden's personal diversion of corporate repair grants into offshore bond trusts.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the proof of embezzled scrubber repairs. The warden offers double payment to wipe it, while the miners demand armed escort to transmit it.

options.label: Fly the proof out and deliver it to system health inspectors
Back the inmate strike against the warden's enforcement patrol
Sell the slate back to the warden and keep out of the strike

beats.public_change: {role:guard_patrol_cutter} establishes an aggressive firing perimeter around {role:penal_rock_complex} to enforce quarantine.

missions.reason: The delegate hires the pilot to destroy the guard cutter so the miners can breach the reserve air depot and force a broadcast.
missions.private_fact: The cutter crew has orders to scuttle the lower habitat shafts if prisoners breach the secure lift.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the maintenance log to system regulators.
resolutions.summary: Regulators revoke the operating lease for {role:penal_rock_complex}. {role:quarry_warden} is removed in disgrace, and emergency scrubbers are installed.

consequences.public_summary: A hauler exposed an asteroid warden who was skimming scrubber credits while convict miners choked.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the guard cutter, enabling the miners to seize the complex.
resolutions.summary: Inmates seize control of {role:penal_rock_complex} after destroying the guard cutter. They fortify the airlocks, establishing an armed labor standoff.

consequences.public_summary: A private prison patrol ship was blown out of orbit during an asteroid quarry mutiny.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the evidence slate back to the warden.
resolutions.summary: {role:quarry_warden} suppresses the labor unrest and destroys the incriminating maintenance records. Rations and air allowances are cut in half.

resolutions.reached_by: Emergency deliveries fail or the pilot ignores the contract.
resolutions.summary: Scrubber failure cripples {role:penal_rock_complex}. {role:quarry_trust_syndicate} evacuates upper supervisory staff, leaving convict shifts in dormant lockdown.

loose_threads.detail: A mining regulator signed off on full scrubber repairs without visiting {role:penal_rock_complex} in eighteen months.
An unlisted logistics broker bought up all secondary water ice reserves in the belt days before the quarry filters choked.
The guard cutter's pulse cannons were billed to a corporate security company that operates solely in an adjacent system.

radio_hooks: Output reports from {role:penal_rock_complex} drop sharply as station management cites technical delays.
Miners' rights advocates petition system authorities over unconfirmed atmospheric leaks in the outer belt.
Security patrols around penal mining leases in {system} increased following rumors of unauthorized comms.

voice_direction.quarry_warden: Speaks in smooth, rehearsed administrative euphemisms. Calls toxic air 'transitional particulate elevation' and never raises his voice.
voice_direction.convict_delegate: Short, breathless phrases worn down by years underground. Blunt, biting humor; avoids speaking of the world beyond the quarry.
